SEOSIGNALX PRIVACY

Privacy Policy

This policy explains how SEOSignalX handles account data, website audit data, integrations, reports, and operational records when you use our SEO intelligence tools.

Effective date: July 5, 2026
/
SEOSignalX home
What SEOSignalX Collects

SEOSignalX collects the information needed to provide technical SEO, semantic SEO, crawl, reporting, and dashboard workflows. The exact data depends on the tools you use and the integrations you connect.

Account details such as name, email address, authentication provider, plan, role, and settings.
Project details such as domains, URLs, crawl scope, selected website, audit settings, saved reports, and issue history.
Fetched SEO data such as HTTP status, headings, meta tags, canonical URLs, image-alt findings, internal links, resources, robots directives, sitemap references, and page source previews.
Integration data that you choose to connect, including Search Console properties, Bing Webmaster API keys, API configuration, and related performance metrics.
Usage and security data such as device/browser signals, log events, feature usage, errors, request timing, and abuse-prevention signals.
Billing records handled through payment providers, including plan status and payment metadata. SEOSignalX does not need to store full card numbers.
How We Use Data

We use this data to run audits, create reports, save your projects, improve crawler accuracy, personalize SEOSignalX dashboards, troubleshoot failures, protect the platform, process subscriptions, and communicate service updates.

We may aggregate or de-identify audit and usage data to understand product performance and improve SEO checks. Aggregated data is not intended to identify a specific customer or website owner.

Reports That Can Be Read Without Login

SEOSignalX supports report viewing for people who are not logged in. When a report is configured for public or shared access, anyone with the report link may be able to read the report content, including the audited URL, scores, checks, recommendations, screenshots, or exported findings included in that report.

Editing projects, changing settings, connecting integrations, and accessing private dashboard areas should remain limited to authorized users. Do not place passwords, private API keys, or confidential customer data inside a report you intend to share publicly.

Firebase, Cloudflare, and Service Providers

SEOSignalX may use Firebase for authentication, database storage, and related app services, and Cloudflare for hosting, functions, proxying, caching, security, and delivery. We may also use analytics, payment, email, error-monitoring, AI, or SEO-data providers to operate specific product features.

Service providers are allowed to process data only for the services they provide to SEOSignalX and are expected to protect it using appropriate technical and organizational safeguards.

Integrations and API Keys

Some tools require third-party access, such as Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, AI providers, or other SEO APIs. You control whether to connect those services and are responsible for making sure you have permission to access the connected website or account.

API keys and tokens should be stored and transmitted only through the intended SEOSignalX settings or secure environment variable paths. Avoid pasting secrets into public reports, comments, page content, or support messages.

Sharing and Disclosure

We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with service providers, when you direct us to share a report, to comply with law, to protect SEOSignalX and users, during a business transfer, or with your consent.

Retention and Security

We keep data for as long as needed to provide SEOSignalX, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, and maintain audit history. You may delete projects or request deletion of account data where required by law and supported by the platform.

We use reasonable security controls such as authentication, access rules, transport security, provider-level protections, and least-privilege operational practices. No internet service can guarantee perfect security, so users should also protect their accounts, passwords, and API credentials.

Your Choices
You can update account and project details inside SEOSignalX where those controls are available.
You can disconnect integrations or rotate API keys from the relevant provider and SEOSignalX settings.
You can choose whether to share report links publicly or keep them within your team.
You can contact us about access, correction, export, or deletion requests, subject to identity verification and legal limits.
Contact

For privacy questions, security concerns, or data requests, contact SEOSignalX support at support@seosignalx.com.

What the Service Provides

SEOSignalX provides SEO intelligence software for website audits, crawl analysis, technical SEO checks, content and semantic SEO workflows, Search Console style reporting, dashboard monitoring, exports, and recommendations. Results are informational and depend on fetched pages, third-party APIs, crawler availability, configuration, and the current search ecosystem.

SEO outcomes are not guaranteed. Rankings, traffic, indexing, and AI-search visibility depend on many factors outside SEOSignalX control.

Website Audits and Authorization

You may use SEOSignalX only on websites, domains, accounts, and data sources that you own, manage, or are authorized to test. You may not use SEOSignalX to attack, overload, scrape private systems, bypass access controls, or collect data in violation of law or third-party terms.

You are responsible for respecting robots rules, customer agreements, platform policies, rate limits, and any legal duties that apply to the websites or accounts you analyze.

Reports and Public Viewing

SEOSignalX may allow reports to be read without a login when a report is public, shared, or configured for unauthenticated viewing. Anyone with access to that link may be able to view the report contents. Keep private data, secrets, restricted URLs, and confidential client information out of publicly shared reports.

Report access for unauthenticated viewers is intended for reading reports only. Project editing, integration changes, private dashboard access, and account administration should remain restricted to authorized users.

Integrations and API Keys

Some SEOSignalX features connect to third-party services such as Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, payment providers, AI APIs, and SEO data APIs. You are responsible for obtaining permission, following provider terms, managing quotas, and protecting credentials.

If you add API keys or tokens to SEOSignalX, you authorize us to use them to provide the requested feature. Rotate or revoke credentials if access is no longer needed.

Plans, Billing, and Changes

Paid plans, usage limits, trials, renewals, refunds, and taxes may be handled through SEOSignalX or a payment provider. Plan features and limits may change as the product evolves. If pricing or paid plan terms materially change, we will provide notice where required.

SEOSignalX owns the platform, software, interface, workflows, branding, templates, and product-generated system logic. Disclaimers and Limitation of Liability

SEOSignalX is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. We do not promise uninterrupted service, perfect data, complete crawl coverage, ranking improvements, search-engine action, or compatibility with every website or provider.
